name: Hot Springs County, WY
findings: Hot Springs County has 31 nonprofit organizations. 15 of them (48%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 13 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (54% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Hot Springs County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Social and fraternal organizations stand out for membership
observations.text: 6 social and fraternal organizations here list membership, compared with about 2 in similar places of this size.

confidence.text: Based on 6 organizations here; 29% of all organizations here have no identified type.
